data.long_meaning: A female name derived from the Old English 'wīh' meaning 'white' and 'nīe' meaning 'island'. In Christianity, it is believed that the name represents a connection to the divine and the purity of the soul. The name Whitney carries the meaning “White Island” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Whitney usually hope their child will grow to embody white island and live with faith, good character and purpose.
